notes.title: Space Wave Race Season 2
notes.notes:
[h1]Welcome to the Season 2 of Space Wave Race, commander![/h1]
We're thrilled to announce the release of Season 2 of Space Wave Race, featuring exciting new features and enhancements to take your intergalactic racing experience to the next level.

Some of the key features and improvements included in the new update are:

[list]
[*] GDPR Menu: At the beginning of the experience, a message will pop up asking players if they consent to collect usage data for improving the experience.

[*] Boss Fight Mechanic: At any point during the race, players may encounter a big enemy, and they will have to fight with a variety of weapons and tactics to defeat them.

[*] Frenzy Taps with Big Asteroids: A new mechanic where players will have to tap quickly to destroy a giant asteroid that occupies all three lanes.

[*] New levels for all leagues: All the races have updated layouts. You can play again to achieve new record times.

[*] New Music: Updated soundtrack for the main menu and all levels, creating an even more immersive experience.

[*] UX Enhancement: Audio ducking when an audio cue sounds, enhancing the overall gaming experience.

[*] Updated tutorial to make it more accessible and introduce new mechanics.
[/list]
Have fun!

notes.title: Forth Update Available
notes.notes:
Patch note:

- Added warning to use headphones at the beggining of the game.
- Added setup options to speedup the voiceover.
- Added descriptions of all the modes and spaceships.
- Updated option menu to read the current status of the selected option.
- Added "Contact" menu option in order to send a email.
- Trimmed silences in the voice clips.
- Added a retry option at the end of a race.
- Minor bugfixes.
